parameters.query: INSERT INTO expenses (date, supplier, description, amount, btw_percentage, btw_amount, total, ledger_account_id) SELECT '{{ $json.datum }}', '{{ $json.leverancier }}', '{{ $json.omschrijving }}', {{ $json.bedrag }}, {{ $json.btw_percentage }}, {{ $json.btw_bedrag }}, {{ $json.totaal }}, id FROM ledger_accounts WHERE code = '{{ $json.grootboek_code }}'
